description: This file defines the PasswordHasher class, which provides functionality for hashing passwords used in spreadsheet protection, including algorithm selection and iterative hashing methods.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A utility class for hashing passwords for spreadsheet protection, supporting multiple algorithms and security features.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Maps a given algorithm name to its corresponding PHP hash algorithm name.

methods.name: defaultHashPassword
methods.description: Generates a password hash using a custom algorithm, based on bitwise operations and verifiers.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Creates a hashed password using a specified algorithm, salt, and iteration count, suitable for spreadsheet protection.
